Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.notification

Class OrderFillMailer

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.notification.OrderFillMailer
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="order.notifications.email", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class OrderFillMailer extends Object
Emails a client how an order that waited ended: filled, refused when its price was reached, or expired. A cancelled order gets nothing, since the client did it, and an order that executed the moment it was placed never waited, so it never owes an email.

A sweep finds every order flagged notice_pending (set when it went OPEN) that has since reached one of those outcomes. Working from the database rather than from events means it also covers fills that PendingFillRecovery finishes later, needs no Kafka, and retries after a mail outage. The client's address and notify_order_fills choice are read straight from the shared iam.clients and iam.client_profile tables. An order is marked notified, in a transaction of its own, only after the mail server accepts the email, so it is never mailed twice apart from a crash in between. A client who opted out, or is not ACTIVE, just has the flag cleared. Nothing here throws: the order is already decided, so a mail failure is logged and retried next sweep.
